affected_groups: People exposed to insecurity in northern Benin
alternative_explanations: Insecurity and regional mobility have independent drivers.
uncertainty: Qualitative CCDR warning; Sahelian in-migration is not a Benin-only causal estimate.
compact_statement: Climate pressures may compound disparities, insecurity and displacement.

climate_pressure: Northern drought, dry spells and water scarcity described in the country context.
documented_impact: Reduced crops and pasture can change the resources available to farming and pastoral livelihoods.
fcv_mediator: Altered transhumance and competition over scarce or degraded land and water interact with pre-existing farmer-herder tensions.
possible_consequence: The project document warns of heightened local tensions; it does not attribute particular incidents or armed-group activity to climate.
alternative_explanations: Land governance, mobility restrictions and insecurity can cause livelihood losses and tensions independently of climate.
uncertainty: Conditional contextual mechanism combining FEWS NET and appraisal narrative; not a localized incident study, causal estimate or prediction. Named attack sites are not treated as climate-conflict cases.
resilience_factors: Proposed participatory refugee/host support is a design response, not an evaluated peace outcome.
compact_statement: In northern Benin, climate-related resource stress may alter transhumance and compound farmer-herder tensions, mediated by land and mobility conditions.
